per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: any OpenAI SDK with base URL https://api.stepfun.ai/v1; curl against POST https://api.stepfun.ai/v1/chat/completions with Authorization: Bearer $STEP_API_KEY.
chaining: the limited-time free audio preview models are the only zero-priced rows; text reasoning models are paid per token

free_tier.stated: No standing token allowance. Billing draws from free credit first and then from the paid balance, free credit can expire, and no credit amount is published on the pages read. The preview speech models stepaudio-3-realtime-preview and stepaudio-3-chat-preview are listed Free (limited time). Text reasoning is paid: step-3.5-flash is USD 0.10 per 1M cache-miss input and USD 0.30 per 1M output

limits.value: tier V0 for cumulative top-up under USD 15: concurrency 5, 100 RPM, 500,000 TPM; the tier rises only with cash top-ups, and vouchers do not count

binding_note: rate tier follows cumulative cash top-up; an account with no top-up starts at the lowest tier

identity_cost.detail: unverified: the overseas documentation (platform.stepfun.ai) states individual accounts must complete identity verification first and names no document or country scope; the mainland sibling platform (platform.stepfun.com) documents an individual real-name check of the holder's name and ID card number with an Alipay face-recognition scan, and it is not stated that the overseas platform uses the same check

reliability_note: text-to-image models step-2x-large and step-image-edit-2 were retired on October 10, 2026 and stopped serving requests
confidence_note: The endpoint, routes and bearer scheme come from first-party docs pages, with the overseas-versus-mainland split stated on the Chinese first-party page; a keyless request returned HTTP 401 as expected. Key value and per-account quota remain unverified behind a sign-up.

interface_detail: OpenAI Chat Completions compatible. The overseas platform is served by the first-party StepFun inference API, with chat at POST https://api.stepfun.ai/v1/chat/completions and models at GET https://api.stepfun.ai/v1/models; auth is a bearer key in Authorization: Bearer $STEP_API_KEY, created on the Interface Keys page after sign-in. The mainland sibling uses https://api.stepfun.com/v1.
notes: A keyless GET or POST to the chat route returns HTTP 401 with body {"error":{"message":"Incorrect API key provided","type":"invalid_api_key"}}; no OpenAPI JSON endpoint was reachable on 2026-11-18. On 2026-11-18 two keyless POSTs to /v1/chat/completions for step-3.5-flash returned HTTP 401 invalid_api_key, so the route is live.
